label: Iron-recycling macrophage
evidence: Term used consistently throughout the paper as one of four macrophage subsets. Supplementary material (peer-review response, line citing PMID:35549310) explicitly lists markers: 'Iron-recycling macrophages: CD5L, APOE, VCAM, TIMD4, SLC40A1'. Snippet search confirms the term 'iron-recycling' appears in the atlas body text (e.g. 'TML, Iron-recycling, LYVE1+ and MHCII+ macrophages') and in Supplementary Tables 22 and 24. The label appears both capitalised ('Iron-recycling macrophage') and lowercased ('iron-recycling macrophage') across the manuscript and supplementary material.
